070  @Test
071  public void testComplexQuery() throws QueryBuildingException {
072    Predicate aves =
073        new EqualsPredicate<>(
074            OccurrenceSearchParameter.TAXON_KEY,
075            "212",
076            false,
077            Constants.NUB_DATASET_KEY.toString());
078    Predicate passer =
079        new LikePredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.SCIENTIFIC_NAME, "Passer*", false);
080    Predicate UK = new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.COUNTRY, "GB", false);
081    Predicate before1989 = new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.YEAR, "1989");
082    Predicate georeferencedPredicate =
083        new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.HAS_COORDINATE, "true", false);
084
085    ConjunctionPredicate p =
086        new ConjunctionPredicate(List.of(aves, UK, passer, before1989, georeferencedPredicate));
087    String where = visitor.buildQuery(p);
088    assertEquals(
089        "(((stringArrayContains(occurrence.gbif_classification.taxonkeys, '212', true))) AND (countrycode = 'GB') AND (lower(occurrence.gbif_classification.scientificname) LIKE lower('Passer%')) AND (year <= 1989) AND (hascoordinate = true))",
090        where);
091  }

120  @Test
121  public void testMoreComplexQuery() throws QueryBuildingException {
122    Predicate taxon1 =
123        new EqualsPredicate<>(
124            OccurrenceSearchParameter.TAXON_KEY, "1", false, Constants.NUB_DATASET_KEY.toString());
125    Predicate taxon2 =
126        new EqualsPredicate<>(
127            OccurrenceSearchParameter.TAXON_KEY, "2", false, Constants.NUB_DATASET_KEY.toString());
128    DisjunctionPredicate taxa = new DisjunctionPredicate(List.of(taxon1, taxon2));
129
130    Predicate basis =
131        new InPredicate<>(
132            OccurrenceSearchParameter.BASIS_OF_RECORD,
133            List.of("HUMAN_OBSERVATION", "MACHINE_OBSERVATION"),
134            false);
135
136    Predicate UK = new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.COUNTRY, "GB", false);
137    Predicate IE = new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.COUNTRY, "IE", false);
138    DisjunctionPredicate countries = new DisjunctionPredicate(List.of(UK, IE));
139
140    Predicate before1989 = new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.YEAR, "1989");
141    Predicate in2000 = new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.YEAR, "2000", false);
142    DisjunctionPredicate years = new DisjunctionPredicate(List.of(before1989, in2000));
143
144    ConjunctionPredicate p = new ConjunctionPredicate(List.of(taxa, basis, countries, years));
145    String where = visitor.buildQuery(p);
146    assertEquals(
147        "(((arrays_overlap(occurrence.gbif_classification.taxonkeys, array('1','2')))) "
148            + "AND ((basisofrecord IN('HUMAN_OBSERVATION', 'MACHINE_OBSERVATION'))) "
149            + "AND ((countrycode IN(\'GB\', \'IE\'))) "
150            + "AND (((year <= 1989) OR (year = 2000))))",
151        where);
152  }

266    String query = visitor.buildQuery(p);

529        "MULTIPOLYGON (((180 -16.658979090909092, 180 -17.12485513597339, 179.87915 -17.12058, 179.78577 -16.82899, 179.85168 -16.72643, 180 -16.658979090909092)), ((-180 -17.12485513597339, -180 -16.658979090909092, -179.8764 -16.60277, -179.75006 -16.86054, -179.89838 -17.12845, -180 -17.12485513597339)))";

531        "(decimallatitude >= -17.12845 AND decimallatitude <= -16.60277 AND (decimallongitude >= 179.78577 OR decimallongitude <= -179.75006))";
532    query = visitor.buildQuery(new WithinPredicate(wktM));

534        "(" + bbox + " AND contains('" + wktM + "', decimallatitude, decimallongitude) = TRUE)",
535        query);

540        "POLYGON((-180.14832 -16.72643, -180.21423 -16.82899, -180.12085 -17.12058, -179.89838 -17.12845, -179.75006 -16.86054, -179.8764 -16.60277, -180.14832 -16.72643))";

555    // Tiny areas scattered around the world, all in a single multipolygon.
556    // Requires bounding boxes to avoid very slow Hive performance.
557    String wktMM =
558        "MULTIPOLYGON (((-109.42861 -27.13333, -109.42861 -27.13666, -109.43138 -27.13666, -109.43138 -27.13333, -109.42861 -27.13333)), "

560            + "((-174.35146 -19.80528, -174.35146 -19.81829, -174.36338 -19.81829, -174.36338 -19.80528, -174.35146 -19.80528)), "
561            + "((-173.94525 -18.71444, -173.96472 -18.71444, -173.96472 -18.68694, -173.94525 -18.68694, -173.94525 -18.71444)), "
562            + "((-173.91655 -18.66372, -173.94041 -18.66372, -173.94041 -18.63616, -173.91655 -18.63616, -173.91655 -18.66372)))";
563    String bboxMM =
564        "(decimallatitude >= -27.13666 AND decimallatitude <= -18.63616 AND (decimallongitude >= -174.36338 AND decimallongitude <= -109.42236)) AND "
565            + "(((decimallatitude >= -27.13666 AND decimallatitude <= -27.13333 AND (decimallongitude >= -109.43138 AND decimallongitude <= -109.42861)) OR "
566            + "(decimallatitude >= -27.11191 AND decimallatitude <= -27.10919 AND (decimallongitude >= -109.42541 AND decimallongitude <= -109.42236)) OR "
567            + "(decimallatitude >= -19.81829 AND decimallatitude <= -19.80528 AND (decimallongitude >= -174.36338 AND decimallongitude <= -174.35146)) OR "

734  @Test
735  public void testDateComparisons() throws QueryBuildingException {
736    Predicate p = new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.LAST_INTERPRETED, "2000", false);
737    String query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
738    assertEquals(
739        String.format(
740            "(lastinterpreted >= %s AND lastinterpreted < %s)",
741            Instant.parse("2000-01-01T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli(),
742            Instant.parse("2001-01-01T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli()),
743        query);
744
745    // Include the range
746    p = new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.LAST_INTERPRETED, "2000");
747    query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
748    assertEquals(
749        String.format("lastinterpreted < %s", Instant.parse("2001-01-01T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli()),
750        query);
751
752    p = new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.LAST_INTERPRETED, "2000");
753    query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
754    assertEquals(
755        String.format(
756            "lastinterpreted >= %s", Instant.parse("2000-01-01T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli()),
757        query);
758
759    // Exclude the range
760    p = new LessThanPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.LAST_INTERPRETED, "2000");
761    query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
762    assertEquals(
763        String.format("lastinterpreted < %s", Instant.parse("2000-01-01T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli()),
764        query);
765
766    p = new GreaterThanPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.LAST_INTERPRETED, "2000");
767    query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
768    assertEquals(
769        String.format(
770            "lastinterpreted >= %s", Instant.parse("2001-01-01T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli()),
771        query);
772  }

820            "(eventdategte >= %s AND eventdatelte < %s)",

879  /** Reusable method to test partial dates, i.e., dates with the format: yyyy, yyyy-MM. */
880  private void testPartialDate(String expectedFrom, String expectedTo, String value)
881      throws QueryBuildingException {
882    Range<Instant> range =
883        Range.closed(
884            expectedFrom == null ? null : Instant.parse(expectedFrom),
885            expectedTo == null ? null : Instant.parse(expectedTo));
886
887    Predicate p = new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.LAST_INTERPRETED, value, false);
888    String query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
889
890    if (!range.hasUpperBound() && !range.hasLowerBound()) {
891      assertEquals("", query);
892    } else if (!range.hasUpperBound()) {
893      assertEquals(
894          String.format("(lastinterpreted >= %s)", range.lowerEndpoint().toEpochMilli()), query);
895    } else if (!range.hasLowerBound()) {
896      assertEquals(
897          String.format("(lastinterpreted < %s)", range.upperEndpoint().toEpochMilli()), query);
898    } else {
899      assertEquals(
900          String.format(
901              "(lastinterpreted >= %s AND lastinterpreted < %s)",
902              range.lowerEndpoint().toEpochMilli(), range.upperEndpoint().toEpochMilli()),
903          query);
904    }
905  }

1019  /** Reusable method to test number ranges. */
1020  private void testDoubleRange(String value) throws QueryBuildingException {
1021    Range<Double> range = SearchTypeValidator.parseDecimalRange(value);
1022
1023    Predicate p = new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.ELEVATION, value, false);
1024    String query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
1025
1026    if (!range.hasUpperBound()) {
1027      assertEquals(String.format("elevation >= %s", range.lowerEndpoint().doubleValue()), query);
1028    } else if (!range.hasLowerBound()) {
1029      assertEquals(String.format("elevation <= %s", range.upperEndpoint().doubleValue()), query);
1030    } else {
1031      assertEquals(
1032          String.format(
1033              "((elevation >= %s) AND (elevation <= %s))",
1034              range.lowerEndpoint().doubleValue(), range.upperEndpoint().doubleValue()),
1035          query);
1036    }
1037  }

1066  @Test
1067  public void testIssues() throws QueryBuildingException {
1068    // EqualsPredicate
1069    String query =
1070        visitor.buildQuery(
1071            new EqualsPredicate<>(
1072                OccurrenceSearchParameter.ISSUE, "TAXON_MATCH_HIGHERRANK", false));
1073    assertEquals("stringArrayContains(issue,'TAXON_MATCH_HIGHERRANK',true)", query);
1074
1075    // InPredicate
1076    query =
1077        visitor.buildQuery(
1078            new InPredicate<>(
1079                OccurrenceSearchParameter.ISSUE,
1080                List.of("TAXON_MATCH_HIGHERRANK", "TAXON_MATCH_NONE"),
1081                false));
1082    assertEquals(
1083        "(stringArrayContains(issue,'TAXON_MATCH_HIGHERRANK',true) OR stringArrayContains(issue,'TAXON_MATCH_NONE',true))",
1084        query);
1085
1086    // LikePredicate
1087    try {
1088      new LikePredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.ISSUE, "TAXON_MATCH_HIGHERRANK", false);
1089      fail();
1090    } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
1091    }
1092
1093    // Not
1094    query =
1095        visitor.buildQuery(
1096            new NotPredicate(
1097                new EqualsPredicate<>(
1098                    OccurrenceSearchParameter.ISSUE, "TAXON_MATCH_HIGHERRANK", false)));
1099    assertEquals("NOT stringArrayContains(issue,'TAXON_MATCH_HIGHERRANK',true)", query);
1100
1101    // Not disjunction
1102    query =
1103        visitor.buildQuery(
1104            new NotPredicate(
1105                new DisjunctionPredicate(
1106                    List.of(
1107                        new EqualsPredicate<>(
1108                            OccurrenceSearchParameter.ISSUE, "COORDINATE_INVALID", false),
1109                        new EqualsPredicate<>(
1110                            OccurrenceSearchParameter.ISSUE, "COORDINATE_OUT_OF_RANGE", false),
1111                        new EqualsPredicate<>(
1112                            OccurrenceSearchParameter.ISSUE, "ZERO_COORDINATE", false),
1113                        new EqualsPredicate<>(
1114                            OccurrenceSearchParameter.ISSUE, "RECORDED_DATE_INVALID", false)))));
1115    assertEquals(
1116        "NOT (stringArrayContains(issue,'COORDINATE_INVALID',true) OR stringArrayContains(issue,'COORDINATE_OUT_OF_RANGE',true) OR stringArrayContains(issue,'ZERO_COORDINATE',true) OR stringArrayContains(issue,'RECORDED_DATE_INVALID',true))",
1117        query);
1118
1119    // IsNotNull
1120    query = visitor.buildQuery(new IsNotNullPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.ISSUE));
1121    assertEquals("(issue IS NOT NULL AND size(issue) > 0)", query);
1122  }

1124  @Test
1125  public void testAllParamsExist() {
1126    List<Predicate> predicates = new ArrayList<>();
1127    for (OccurrenceSearchParameter param : OccurrenceSearchParameter.values()) {
1128      String value1 = "7";
1129      String value2 = "9";
1130      if (OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOMETRY == param) {
1131        predicates.add(new WithinPredicate("POLYGON ((30 10, 10 20, 20 40, 40 40, 30 10))"));
1132        continue;
1133      } else if (OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEO_DISTANCE == param) {
1134        predicates.add(new GeoDistancePredicate("10", "20", "10km"));
1135        continue;
1136      } else if (UUID.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
1137        value1 = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
1138        value2 = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
1139      } else if (Boolean.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
1140        value1 = "true";
1141        value2 = "false";
1142      } else if (Country.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
1143        value1 = Country.GERMANY.getIso2LetterCode();
1144        value2 = Country.FRANCE.getIso3LetterCode();
1145      } else if (Language.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
1146        value1 = Language.GERMAN.getIso2LetterCode();
1147        value2 = Language.FRENCH.getIso3LetterCode();
1148      } else if (Enum.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
1149        Enum<?>[] values = ((Class<Enum>) param.type()).getEnumConstants();
1150        value1 = values[0].name();
1151        value2 = values[1].name();
1152      } else if (Date.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
1153        value1 = "2014-01-23";
1154        value2 = null;
1155      } else if (IsoDateInterval.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
1156        value1 = "2014-01-23,2015-05";
1157        value2 = null;
1158      }
1159
1160      predicates.add(new EqualsPredicate<>(param, value1, false));
1161      if (value2 != null) {
1162        predicates.add(new InPredicate<>(param, List.of(value1, value2), false));
1163      }
1164    }
1165    ConjunctionPredicate and = new ConjunctionPredicate(predicates);
1166    try {
1167      String allParams = visitor.buildQuery(and);
1168    } catch (QueryBuildingException e) {
1169      fail(e);
1170    }
1171  }

1173  @Test
1174  public void testVocabularies() {
1175    SQLColumnsUtils sqlColumnsUtils = new SQLColumnsUtils("occurrence");
1176
1177    Arrays.stream(OccurrenceSearchParameter.values())
1178        .filter(
1179            p ->
1180                Optional.ofNullable(visitor.term(p))
1181                    .map(SQLColumnsUtils::isVocabulary)
1182                    .orElse(false))
1183        .forEach(
1184            param -> {
1185              try {
1186                String hiveQueryField = sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(visitor.term(param));
1187
1188                // EqualsPredicate
1189                String query = visitor.buildQuery(new EqualsPredicate<>(param, "value_1", false));
1190                assertEquals("stringArrayContains(" + hiveQueryField + ",'value_1',false)", query);
1191
1192                // InPredicate
1193                query =
1194                    visitor.buildQuery(
1195                        new InPredicate<>(param, List.of("value_1", "value_2"), false));
1196                assertEquals(
1197                    "(stringArrayContains("
1198                        + hiveQueryField
1199                        + ",'value_1',false) OR stringArrayContains("
1200                        + hiveQueryField
1201                        + ",'value_2',false))",
1202                    query);
1203
1204                // LikePredicate
1205                query = visitor.buildQuery(new LikePredicate<>(param, "value_*", false));
1206                assertEquals("lower(" + hiveQueryField + ") LIKE lower('value\\_%')", query);
1207
1208                // Not
1209                query =
1210                    visitor.buildQuery(
1211                        new NotPredicate(new EqualsPredicate<>(param, "value_1", false)));
1212                assertEquals(
1213                    "NOT stringArrayContains(" + hiveQueryField + ",'value_1',false)", query);
1214
1215                // IsNotNull
1216                query = visitor.buildQuery(new IsNotNullPredicate<>(param));
1217                assertEquals(
1218                    "(" + hiveQueryField + " IS NOT NULL AND size(" + hiveQueryField + ") > 0)",
1219                    query);
1220
1221                // IsNull
1222                query = visitor.buildQuery(new IsNullPredicate<>(param));
1223                if (visitor.isSQLArray(param)) {
1224                  assertEquals(
1225                      " (" + hiveQueryField + " IS NULL OR size(" + hiveQueryField + ") = 0) ",
1226                      query);
1227                } else {
1228                  assertEquals(hiveQueryField + " IS NULL", query);
1229                }
1230
1231              } catch (QueryBuildingException ex) {
1232                throw new RuntimeException(ex);
1233              }
1234            });
1235  }

1273  @Test
1274  public void testGeoTimePredicate() throws QueryBuildingException {
1275    Predicate predicate =
1276        new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME, "12", false);
1277    String query = visitor.buildQuery(predicate);
1278    assertEquals("geologicaltime.gt >= 12 AND geologicaltime.lte <= 12", query);
1279
1280    Predicate rangePredicate =
1281        new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME, "12,15", false);
1282    query = visitor.buildQuery(rangePredicate);
1283    assertEquals("geologicaltime.gt >= 12.0 AND geologicaltime.lte <= 15.0", query);
1284
1285    rangePredicate =
1286        new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME, "12,*", false);
1287    query = visitor.buildQuery(rangePredicate);
1288    assertEquals("geologicaltime.gt >= 12.0", query);
1289
1290    rangePredicate =
1291        new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME, "*,15", false);
1292    query = visitor.buildQuery(rangePredicate);
1293    assertEquals("geologicaltime.lte <= 15.0", query);
1294
1295    Predicate greaterThanOrEqualsPredicate =
1296        new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME, "12");
1297    query = visitor.buildQuery(greaterThanOrEqualsPredicate);
1298    assertEquals("geologicaltime.gt >= 12", query);
1299
1300    Predicate greaterThanPredicate =
1301        new GreaterThanPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME, "12");
1302    query = visitor.buildQuery(greaterThanPredicate);
1303    assertEquals("geologicaltime.lte > 12", query);
1304
1305    Predicate lessThanOrEqualsPredicate =
1306        new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME, "15");
1307    query = visitor.buildQuery(lessThanOrEqualsPredicate);
1308    assertEquals("geologicaltime.lte <= 15", query);
1309
1310    Predicate lessThanPredicate =
1311        new LessThanPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME, "15");
1312    query = visitor.buildQuery(lessThanPredicate);
1313    assertEquals("geologicaltime.gt < 15", query);
1314
1315    ConjunctionPredicate greaterAndLessPredicate =
1316        new ConjunctionPredicate(List.of(greaterThanPredicate, lessThanPredicate));
1317    query = visitor.buildQuery(greaterAndLessPredicate);
1318    assertEquals("((geologicaltime.lte > 12) AND (geologicaltime.gt < 15))", query);
1319
1320    InPredicate inPredicate =
1321        new InPredicate(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME, List.of("12", "15"), false);
1322    query = visitor.buildQuery(inPredicate);
1323    assertEquals(
1324        "((geologicaltime.gt >= 12 AND geologicaltime.lte <= 12) OR (geologicaltime.gt >= 15 AND geologicaltime.lte <= 15))",
1325        query);
1326
1327    IsNotNullPredicate notNullPredicate =
1328        new IsNotNullPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME);
1329    query = visitor.buildQuery(notNullPredicate);
1330    assertEquals("geologicaltime.gt IS NOT NULL", query);
1331  }

1599  @Test
1600  public void testSequenceLengthComplexRange() throws QueryBuildingException {
1601    Predicate p =
1602        new ConjunctionPredicate(
1603            List.of(
1604                new InPredicate<>(
1605                    OccurrenceSearchParameter.OCCURRENCE_STATUS, List.of("PRESENT"), false),
1606                new DisjunctionPredicate(
1607                    List.of(
1608                        new ConjunctionPredicate(
1609                            List.of(
1610                                new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(
1611                                    OccurrenceSearchParameter.NUCLEOTIDE_SEQUENCE_SEQUENCE_LENGTH,
1612                                    "10"),
1613                                new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(
1614                                    OccurrenceSearchParameter.NUCLEOTIDE_SEQUENCE_SEQUENCE_LENGTH,
1615                                    "20"))),
1616                        new ConjunctionPredicate(
1617                            List.of(
1618                                new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(
1619                                    OccurrenceSearchParameter.NUCLEOTIDE_SEQUENCE_SEQUENCE_LENGTH,
1620                                    "20"),
1621                                new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(
1622                                    OccurrenceSearchParameter.NUCLEOTIDE_SEQUENCE_SEQUENCE_LENGTH,
1623                                    "30")))))));
1624    String query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
1625    assertEquals(
1626        "(((occurrencestatus IN('PRESENT'))) AND (((((dna.sequencelength >= 10) AND (dna.sequencelength <= 20))) OR (((dna.sequencelength >= 20) AND (dna.sequencelength <= 30))))))",
1627        query);
1628  }

1630  @Test
1631  public void conjunctionWithNotPredicateTest() throws QueryBuildingException {
1632    Predicate predicate =
1633        new ConjunctionPredicate(
1634            Arrays.asList(
1635                new InPredicate(
1636                    OccurrenceSearchParameter.DATASET_KEY,
1637                    Arrays.asList(
1638                        "b364710b-3f07-4876-a554-1943b702363f",
1639                        "6595e04b-13d2-4eac-933f-73786627b5a2"),
1640                    false // matchCase
1641                    ),
1642                new NotPredicate(
1643                    new ConjunctionPredicate(
1644                        Arrays.asList(
1645                            new InPredicate(
1646                                OccurrenceSearchParameter.INSTITUTION_KEY,
1647                                List.of("75f50140-830d-4630-a290-3d6e951a7c29"),
1648                                false),
1649                            new InPredicate(
1650                                OccurrenceSearchParameter.COLLECTION_KEY,
1651                                List.of("2294871f-f0f7-44b2-b707-e9511ff5a878"),
1652                                false))))));
1653    String query = visitor.buildQuery(predicate);
1654    String expectedQuery =
1655        "(((occurrence.datasetkey IN('b364710b-3f07-4876-a554-1943b702363f', '6595e04b-13d2-4eac-933f-73786627b5a2'))) AND (NOT (((lower(institutionkey) IN(lower('75f50140-830d-4630-a290-3d6e951a7c29')))) AND ((lower(collectionkey) IN(lower('2294871f-f0f7-44b2-b707-e9511ff5a878')))))))";
1656    assertEquals(expectedQuery, query);
1657  }
